description: FCM payload contract between Atlas server (Atlas Claude) and Android shell (Android Claude). This artifact is the authoritative boundary document. Neither implementation agent may deviate from the field names, types, or message structure defined here without a version bump and explicit review.

message_structure.description: Data-only FCM message. The top-level 'notification' key must be absent. All payload fields are nested under 'data'. All values are strings.
message_structure.rationale: Data-only messages are received by the app FirebaseMessagingService regardless of foreground or background state. A notification-type message would bypass the app and render without label support, violating the contract requirement that the Android shell controls all notification rendering.

fields.name: notification_id
fields.purpose: Unique identifier for this notification. Used by Android shell to correlate with cancel or replace operations if needed in future slices. Must be present on every message.

fields.name: title
fields.purpose: Primary notification text. Rendered as the notification title in the Android notification tray.

fields.name: body
fields.purpose: Secondary notification text. Rendered as the notification body in the Android notification tray.

fields.name: label
fields.purpose: User-visible label displayed in the notification. Indicates the originating feature to the user. Must be visibly rendered — not hidden or omitted. The Android shell must include this in the notification UI.

fields.name: deep_link
fields.purpose: Atlas destination URL to open when the user taps the notification. Must use the atlas:// scheme. The Android shell opens this URL via the registered intent filter for atlas:// URIs.

excluded_fields.name: source
excluded_fields.reason: Platform-internal field. Not needed by Android shell for rendering or routing. Including it would expose platform metadata unnecessarily.

excluded_fields.name: fcm_token
excluded_fields.reason: Platform-internal dispatch field. Never included in the payload sent to the device.

excluded_fields.name: status
excluded_fields.reason: Platform-internal lifecycle field. Not part of the device-facing contract.

deep_link_scheme.android_requirement: The Android shell must register an intent filter for the atlas:// URI scheme. The Chrome Custom Tab setup must be configured to hand off atlas:// URIs to the native intent handler rather than loading them in the browser tab.
deep_link_scheme.rationale: atlas:// is a custom URI scheme that routes directly to Android intent handling without requiring HTTPS App Links verification (which requires domain ownership verification and HTTPS infrastructure). For a personal-use app with a known shell, custom scheme is simpler and more reliable for this slice.

android_shell_contract.on_receipt: Android shell receives the FCM data message in its FirebaseMessagingService.onMessageReceived() handler. The shell constructs a native Android notification using the generic platform notification style. All five payload fields must be read from message.data.
android_shell_contract.notification_rendering: The Android shell must render a native Android notification with: title from the 'title' field, body text from the 'body' field, and the 'label' field visibly displayed (e.g., as a subtext, ticker, or notification category line). The exact visual placement of label within the notification UI is an Android Claude decision, subject to the constraint that it must be visible to the user.
android_shell_contract.on_tap: When the user taps the notification, the Android shell opens the deep_link URI using the registered intent handling for atlas:// scheme. This must navigate the user to the specified Atlas destination within the app.
android_shell_contract.notification_style: All notifications in this slice use the same generic Android notification style. No source-specific rendering, channel separation, or visual customisation is required or permitted in this slice.
android_shell_contract.cancel_on_device: Removing an already-displayed notification from the Android notification tray is out of scope for this slice. The notification_id field is included in the payload to support future cancel-on-device behavior without a contract change.

atlas_server_contract.message_type: FCM HTTP v1 API data-only message
atlas_server_contract.credential: FCM service account JSON loaded at startup from FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON_PATH or FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON_CONTENT environment variable
atlas_server_contract.all_values_are_strings: All data payload values must be serialised as strings before sending. No integer, boolean, or nested object values are permitted in FCM data payloads.
atlas_server_contract.no_notification_key: The FCM Message object must not include a 'notification' field (firebase_admin.messaging.Notification). Only the 'data' dict is populated.

versioning.change_policy: Any addition of a new required field is a breaking change and requires a version bump. Addition of a new optional field that the Android shell may safely ignore is a minor change. Field removal or rename is always breaking. Changes must be reviewed before Android Claude implementation begins or resumes.
